# `csharp_empty_block_style`

How an empty method, constructor, accessor or control-flow body is laid out. together_same_line keeps { } on the signature's line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `multiline` |  |
| `together` |  |
| `together_same_line` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Conformance

Curb's output is not always a fixed point of the tool(s) below for this key — see [conformance divergences](../../design-principles/conformance-divergences.md) for the full registry.

- **dotnet-format-whitespace**: csharp_empty_block_style is a ReSharper-only key dotnet format does not recognise at all, but that does not make it inert: what it asks for still has to survive the IDE0055 keys dotnet format does read. Alone it does (verified: `together` alone survives). With csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = false it survives only because Curb defers to that key: dotnet format moves a statement's body, an empty `{ }` included, off its header's line, so together_same_line leaves an empty if/else/loop/using/lock/fixed/try/unsafe body where csharp_new_line_before_open_brace puts it rather than joining it (issue #131; EmptyBlockStyleTests.An_empty_statement_body_stays_off_its_header_line_when_statements_are_not_preserved). The divergence that remains appears combined with csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = false, an IDE0055 key dotnet format does understand as 'expand every single-line block' — including the empty one Curb just recollapsed under the together opinion. The two options are in permanent, direct conflict whenever both are set this way; there is no shape Curb could choose that satisfies both at once. (`EmptyBlockStyleTests.Together_ignores_preserve_single_line_blocks_being_off`)
- **ide0055**: Same direct conflict as the dotnet-format-whitespace entry above between csharp_empty_block_style and csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = false, now confirmed to reproduce under a real `dotnet build -p:EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=true` as well as the `dotnet format whitespace` CLI. (`EmptyBlockStyleTests.Together_ignores_preserve_single_line_blocks_being_off`)

### `csharp_empty_block_style = multiline`

```ini
csharp_empty_block_style = multiline
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public void Empty() { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public void Empty()
    {
    }
}
```
:::

::::
